title: Ollama Native Generate API Request
description: Normalized request schema for POST /api/generate derived from Ollama's public API docs (github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/api.md, rev 2026-08-11, release v0.32.11). Hand-authored, like ollama:v1; the 'v1-generate' version is synthetic and keeps /api/generate fixtures and schema separate from /api/chat. Deliberately permissive: prompt is optional because a missing or empty prompt is Ollama's model load/unload request.

prompt.description: Optional; absent or empty means load/unload the model.
